bio: Bartender and mixologist. Stirred, shaken, never rushed — cocktails for grown-ups, served with a story. Adults only.
avatar: Portrait of a man in his mid 30s with a well-groomed beard and rolled-up shirt sleeves behind a dim bar, amber bar lights, charming smile, shoulders-up, photographic, fictional person
banner: Ultra-wide panoramic photograph of a dim cocktail bar with rows of bottles lit amber behind the counter, a copper shaker in the middle band, cinematic

collections.title: Behind the bar
collections.description: Four drinks and a closing time.

videos.title: Old fashioned, stirred slow
videos.description: Ice, bitters and a spiral of orange peel.
videos.still: Vertical photograph of a bartender's hand stirring an amber old fashioned in a mixing glass with a long bar spoon, amber bar lights, no face, no text
videos.motion: The spoon stirs slowly and ice clinks, an orange peel twists and its oil mists in the light.

videos.title: Shake it, strain it
videos.description: A copper shaker and a coupe glass.
videos.still: Wide photograph of a bartender shaking a copper cocktail shaker above a row of coupe glasses on a dark bar, amber backlight, no face, no text
videos.motion: The shaker moves rhythmically with a splash of light, the liquid pours into a coupe, slow camera push-in.

videos.title: Flame on the orange peel
videos.description: A flare of citrus oil over a glass.
videos.still: Vertical photograph of a hand squeezing an orange peel over a lit match making a small flare above a cocktail glass, dark bar background, no face, no text
videos.motion: The peel is squeezed and a small flare of citrus flame lights the glass, sparks fade, subtle macro drift.

videos.title: Bar close, chairs up
videos.description: Lights low after the last guest.
videos.still: Wide photograph of an empty cocktail bar after closing with chairs up on tables, warm amber lights dimming and bottles glowing behind the counter, no people, no text
videos.motion: Lights dim slowly and the bottles glow, haze drifts, slow gentle push-in.
